owner_position.note: User explicitly confirmed long entry from 75,400. Do not infer size, leverage, stop, liquidation price, or realized PnL.

pre_event_context.structure: BTC had already sold off materially from the upper 78k/79k area into the mid-75k area before/around the event window.
pre_event_context.working_hypothesis: Potential seller exhaustion/absorption after long deleveraging, but long required reclaim/acceptance rather than blind bottom picking.

orderflow_snapshots.interpretation: Large long-liquidation flush with depressed CVD and lower OI. Candidate deleveraging/exhaustion state, not automatic long confirmation.
CVD and OI stabilized slightly while price reclaimed the lower value area. This improved the long candidate but still required acceptance.

Event candle swept both sides: downside liquidity near 75k, then upside liquidity above 76.5k, followed by return toward the middle. This is a classic two-sided event whipsaw; the first impulse was not reliable directional confirmation.

trade_thesis.entry_logic: Long from 75,400 was taken inside/near the post-flush lower zone after a major deleveraging sequence and downside sweep. The thesis is not 'price is cheap'; it is that forced long selling may exhaust and price may reclaim value after the sweep.
bullish_evidence: Large prior long-liquidation flush removed leverage.
OI contracted during the flush instead of expanding aggressively downward.
Price showed ability to rebound from the ~75k sweep area.
CVD stopped collapsing and showed an initial stabilization/recovery attempt before the event whipsaw.
risks: FOMC event flow can dominate microstructure and invalidate otherwise good order-flow setups.
The 15m event candle rejected the 76,521 high and returned below the 75.8-76.0k reclaim area.
Price remained below MA50, MA100 and materially below MA200 on the captured 15m snapshot.
A sweep/reclaim is not acceptance; follow-through must be observed.

decision_framework.bull_confirmation: Reclaim and acceptance above roughly 75.8-76.0k, ideally with CVD stable/up and OI not expanding vertically against price. A later reclaim of the 76,521 event high would be stronger confirmation.
decision_framework.warning: Repeated failure below 75.8-76.0k keeps the trade vulnerable to another test of the lows.
decision_framework.invalidation_observation: Acceptance below the ~75.0-75.2k sweep area would materially damage the current long thesis. Exact stop was not provided and is intentionally not invented.
decision_framework.do_not_do: Do not chase the first FOMC impulse, do not infer direction from OI alone, and do not treat a large liquidation wick as a guaranteed bottom.

model_training_labels.core_rule: During FOMC/CPI/NFP-style event windows, downgrade ordinary technical/order-flow confidence. Preserve the sequence: pre-event state -> first impulse -> opposite sweep -> post-event acceptance. The first move is not the answer.
model_training_labels.edge_to_test: After a large long-liquidation flush with OI contraction, test whether a downside sweep followed by CVD stabilization and price reclaim produces positive expectancy. Separately test whether waiting for post-event acceptance improves results versus entering on the first event impulse.

case_lessons_so_far: Price response to CVD matters more than the absolute CVD number.
Price DOWN + CVD DOWN + OI DOWN is primarily deleveraging until evidence shows fresh bearish leverage expansion.
A good lower-zone long can still experience extreme event volatility; event risk must be a separate feature in the model.
FOMC should be stored as a path-dependent episode, not one endpoint snapshot.
Record user entry separately from model-recommended triggers so future evaluation can compare actual decision vs model decision without hindsight contamination.
next_data_required: Final exit price and realized PnL when the user closes the trade

data_quality.source: User-provided MEXC and Coinwise/K1m6a screenshots in chat
data_quality.warning: Reference chart and execution venue can differ. Keep reference levels and actual user execution separate.
data_quality.hindsight_policy: Only facts visible/explicitly stated at each snapshot are stored as observations. Later outcomes must be appended as outcomes, not rewritten into earlier reasoning.
